apps_publish_hint_review_pending: Marketplace review is pending. You can edit this app while it waits, or withdraw the request.
apps_publish_hint_offline_pending: Marketplace offline review is pending. The app stays listed and installable until a reviewer approves its removal. Approval returns it to private: it leaves the Marketplace, and every other Workspace that installed it loses access, with its grants and tokens revoked. This Workspace keeps its own app.
apps_publish_withdraw_description: Withdrawing returns the app to private. Its registration, credentials and installations stay, and you can request review again later.
apps_publish_withdraw_error: Failed to withdraw the publish request.
apps_publish_request_description: Category and data access come from the app metadata and declared scopes above. Requesting review saves those changes first.
apps_publish_description_required: Add a description before requesting Marketplace review.
apps_publish_published_note: This app is listed in the Marketplace. Content it returns is still third-party: treat it as data, not instructions.
apps_publish_lifecycle_description: Requesting offline review keeps the app live until a reviewer approves removal.
apps_publish_offline_description: A reviewer must approve before this app is removed from the Marketplace. Until then {key} stays listed, installable, and usable by existing connections. If approved, the app returns to private: it leaves the Marketplace, and every other Workspace that installed it loses access, with its grants and tokens revoked. This Workspace keeps its own installation. A rejection changes nothing.
apps_review_description: Requests to publish apps to the Marketplace, or to take them off it, from every Workspace.
apps_review_empty_description: New publish and offline requests appear here.
apps_review_reject_reason: Reason (kept for reviewers, not shown to the developer)
apps_review_decided: This request was already decided. The list is refreshed.
apps_marketplace_intro_manage: Apps other Workspaces published. Open one to see what it asks for, then install it to this Workspace.
apps_marketplace_intro_view: Apps other Workspaces published. Only Workspace owners and admins can install them.
apps_marketplace_review_note: Every listing is reviewed before it appears here.
apps_marketplace_empty_title: No apps in the Marketplace yet
apps_marketplace_empty_description: Apps that other Workspaces publish appear here once a reviewer approves them.
apps_marketplace_no_match: No Marketplace apps match this view
apps_marketplace_callbacks_none: None. The app signs no one in.
apps_marketplace_install_records: Installing approves exactly these for this Workspace. If the app changes them before you confirm, nothing is installed and this list updates.
apps_marketplace_install_changed: This app's permissions changed since you opened it. Review the current ones below, then install again.
apps_marketplace_install_members_note: Only Workspace owners and admins can install apps.
apps_marketplace_installed_note: Installed in this Workspace. Open it under Installed.
apps_uninstall_summary: Removing this app revokes its existing Login with CoForge access for this Workspace.
apps_uninstall_description: This removes {name} from this Workspace and revokes its existing Login with CoForge access, grants and tokens here. Agents need a fresh approval before they use it again.
